label: roster
description: Keeps the latest message from each sender, by a key field, and sends the list when it changes. Entries not heard from within the timeout are dropped or marked inactive.

properties.name: key
properties.label: key field
properties.help: the field that identifies a sender: a message field such as addr or topic, or payload.<name> for one inside the payload

properties.name: timeoutS
properties.label: timeout (s)
properties.help: an entry not heard from for this long has expired

properties.name: merge
properties.label: keep fields a new message leaves empty
properties.help: an empty value ('' or None) in a new message doesn't replace the stored one, e.g. a device's name

properties.name: maxEntries
properties.label: max entries
properties.help: when full, the inactive and then the longest-silent entry make room

properties.name: sortBy
properties.label: sort by (highest first)
properties.help: a field of the entries, such as rssi; blank sorts the most recently heard first
